profile.name: Laura Bennett
profile.summary: KS2 class teacher with QTS and 6 years' experience; maths subject leader, strong communicator and team player.

descriptions: Planned and taught National Curriculum lessons for a class of 30 Year 4 pupils
Used assessment for learning to track pupil progress each half-term; 88% met age-related expectations
Differentiated work for 5 pupils with SEN, working closely with the SENCo
Led maths as subject leader across KS2 since 2021
Ran weekly phonics catch-up groups for 8 pupils
Kept parents informed through termly meetings and Google Classroom updates
Completed annual safeguarding and child protection training

educations.school: University of the West of England

descriptions: Google Classroom, ICT, behaviour management (Positive Behaviour Policy)
